The `VehicleDetails` FBX files use separate wheel, tire and rim parts derived from the imported meshes under their respective licenses above. The `VehicleLamps` FBX files hold emissive headlamp inserts fitted to the body surfaces.

Vehicle marks identify their original vehicle designs. Nightshift uses its own road, interface, audio and gameplay content.
